messages:
sam: heads-up: onboarding-js sample triggered a funky combo of Retry-After slowdowns + auth refresh that results in stale-page replays when prefetch > 2.

rita: can you paste the tiny repro or logs? is this auth-refresh-specific or generic 429 handling?

sam: looks auth-related. log snippet: 
```
DBG fetch cursor=C1 -> items=20
DBG response 401 -> token refresh start
DBG token refresh ok
DBG retry original request (cursor=C1) -> 429 Retry-After=15s
DBG other prefetches advance cursor -> latest=C4
(wait 15s)
DBG retry request resumes -> 400 cursor_expired OR returns same page -> duplicate
```

chen: two knobs: 1) client backoff can be longer than cursor lifetime so retries hit expired cursors, 2) HTTP retry replays raw body with old cursor snapshot. Both combine badly for prefetch.

rita: quick workaround: set prefetch=1 or clamp max backoff to something smaller than cursor TTL in the sampleapp. did you test that?

sam: lowering backoff max to 6s (cursor TTL ~20s) and prefetch=2 removed duplicates in stress run.

chen: long-term fix ideas: 
- add a retry guard hook in SDK: shouldReplay(oldReq, paginatorState) -> bool. paginator uses it to reject replays when oldReq.cursor != state.latestCursor(streamId).
- add a retryStrategy option: {replay, refreshThenFetchLatest, drop}. default for paginators = refreshThenFetchLatest.
- emit telemetry when a replay is dropped or upgraded to fetch-latest: metric paginator.retry_decision{action:drop|replay|refresh}.

rita: parity note: python sdk already exposes a `safe_replay` option; JS and go should match. also add a small e2e that injects a 401 mid-prefetch and asserts no duplicate pages.

sam: i sketched a tiny shouldReplay implementation for JS that checks a global cursor map. gist: 
```
function shouldReplay(oldBody, state, streamId) {
  return oldBody.cursor === state.latestCursor(streamId);
}
```
This returns false when cursor moved.

chen: that's fine for a prototype but real impl should accept a hook so apps with custom semantics can override. also make the default behavior conservative for paginated endpoints.

sdk-bot: Issue created #9001: "js: retry guard + strategy for paginators to prevent stale-cursor replays"

rita: action items: sam open PR with retryGuard + sampleapp doc update recommending prefetch <= 2 until feature ships; chen to propose SDK API shape for parity; qa-bot to add e2e simulating auth refresh + long Retry-After.

qa-bot: note for e2e: simulate 401 for the second prefetch and respond to retried request with 429 Retry-After=20s, then advance cursor on server side during that window. assert no duplicate pages after run.

sam: will open PR with repro + docs. thanks.

chen: also add a short note to changelog if default retry semantics change (minor version).

sam: good call. ping @rita for review once PR is up.
